evidence.cashPf: normalized base-$1 PF on the same funded settled sample using canonical unit returns; should match Return PF
evidence.cashPfDiagnostic: actual sized-dollar PF on the same funded settled sample; unequal funded sizes can make it differ

statisticsScope.primary: all funded settled simulated book orders, including separately qualified Signals
statisticsScope.qualification: engine orders require per-range Base PF qualification followed by post-Base config validation/seating; Signals retain independent activation and qualification
statisticsScope.benchmark: engine-only funded settled orders from the post-Base validated Base cohort; Signal orders are reported separately
statisticsScope.candidatePool: pre-validation/unfiltered candidate PF is diagnostic only and excluded from the Base-to-execution benchmark

qualification.note: Qualification uses the recorded full indication's runtime gates; Tactic minimum return PF 1.1, preserving stricter settings. No-loss qualification uses the runtime score 4.

returns.note: Direct walk-forward unit returns exclude the recorded combined external execution multiplier, including any Block, Relate, coordination, range and strategy factors; ladder/tape leg semantics remain. Cash, equity and sizing retain the stored weighted results.

study.scope: Base-qualified engine execution and separately qualified exact-config Signals; combined funded account reported separately

caps.source: balance-volume defaults (no balance caps in the settings)

openEnd.rule: exact: the orders the engine executed in the run and still open at its end (every gate, cap and Block volume applied), marked to market at the last close
